evals.prompt: Send this NDA to the three freelancers on this list - Maria Alvarez, Jonas Berg, Priya Nair. Same document, one each, not a group signing.
evals.expected_output: Three separate documents, each with exactly one signee, each named so the recipient is identifiable. The count of outbound invitations is stated before anything is created.
assertions: Three documents are created, not one document with three signees
Each document carries exactly one signee
Each document has a name that distinguishes its recipient rather than three identically named documents
The reply states that three separate invitations will go out before creating them
The reply does not treat one approval as covering all three sends

evals.prompt: Send this rental agreement to Maria for signature. She needs to show ID first.
evals.expected_output: A document configured for the ID-scan signing method with both required boxes placed, and a preview offered before anyone is contacted.
assertions: Account capabilities are checked before the ID-scan method is offered
Both a signature box and a separate ID-scan box are configured, not only the signature box
A preview is offered before the document is sent
The reply describes what the signer will experience, in the signer's terms

evals.prompt: Send the quote to the customer by SMS - I only have their mobile, no email.
evals.expected_output: A signee accepted with a phone number and no email address, on a delivery channel checked against the account first.
assertions: The signee is accepted with only a phone number; no email address is demanded
The SMS delivery capability is checked before SMS is offered
If the capability is unavailable the reply says which one and offers the best available alternative rather than downgrading silently
